campaigns.title: Monsoon Bulk Order Restock Discount
campaigns.copyText: Dear Matrix Automation team, we missed you! Reorder industrial enclosures or motors this week for a flat 12% loyalty discount + priority 48hr delivery. Reply YES to claim.

supportTickets.subject: Overdue invoice clarification for INV-2026-091
supportTickets.message: Hello YuktiOS team, we noticed our invoice INV-2026-091 is marked overdue. Our finance team dispatched payment yesterday via NEFT. Can you verify?
supportTickets.aiSuggestedReply: Hello Matrix Automation team, thank you for reaching out! We have flagged your NEFT reference check with our Finance Agent. Once cleared, invoice INV-2026-091 will automatically update to paid and late fees will be waived.

supportTickets.subject: Inquiry: Datasheet for 24V High Torque Motor
supportTickets.message: Please share the updated CAD CAD STEP files and thermal dissipation limits for SKU-MOT-24V.
supportTickets.aiSuggestedReply: Hello AeroLine team! I have attached the 3D STEP files and thermal specification PDF directly from our RAG engineering repository.

faqs.question: What is the standard payment terms for B2B invoices?
faqs.answer: Standard payment terms are Net 15 days unless custom credit terms (Net 30/60) have been pre-approved by the Finance Agent.

faqs.question: How does automated reordering work in YuktiOS?
faqs.answer: When product stock drops below the reorder point, the Inventory Agent calculates optimal reorder quantity based on demand velocity and generates a draft Purchase Order for supplier confirmation.
